title: build fail with --enable-preview and hibernate-orm
body:
**Describe the bug**
Build fails as soon as --enable-preview is passed to the maven-compiler-plugin compilerArgs

Affected quarkus versions (at least): 
1.3.2.Final
1.4.0.Final

**Expected behavior**
Build without fail

**Actual behavior**
Build failed or at least maven stacktrace + missing .class files


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Check out https://github.com/HonoluluHenk/quarkus-enable-preview-fail
2. configure JDK13
3. `./mvnw clean install`

```
[INFO] --- quarkus-maven-plugin:1.3.2.Final:build (default) @ enable-preview-fail ---
[INFO] [org.jboss.threads] JBoss Threads version 3.0.1.Final
[INFO] [org.hibernate.Version] HHH000412: Hibernate ORM core version 5.4.14.Final
[ERROR] [io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.HibernateOrmProcessor] Failed to generate build time Hibernate proxy definitions. This is a bug, please file an issue at https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues and this stack trace.
java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: Preview features are not enabled for org/acme/FooEntity (class file version 57.65535). Try running with '--enable-preview'
    at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass1 (Native Method)
    at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass (ClassLoader.java:1016)
    at io.quarkus.bootstrap.classloading.QuarkusClassLoader.loadClass (QuarkusClassLoader.java:316)
    at io.quarkus.bootstrap.classloading.QuarkusClassLoader.loadClass (QuarkusClassLoader.java:275)
    at java.lang.Class.forName0 (Native Method)
    at java.lang.Class.forName (Class.java:416)
    at io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.HibernateOrmProcessor.generatedProxies (HibernateOrmProcessor.java:317)
    at io.quarkus.hibernate.orm.deployment.HibernateOrmProcessor.build (HibernateOrmProcessor.java:278)
    at jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke0 (Native Method)
    at jdk.internal.reflect.NativeMethodAccessorImpl.invoke (NativeMethodAccessorImpl.java:62)
    at jdk.internal.reflect.DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.invoke (DelegatingMethodAccessorImpl.java:43)
    at java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke (Method.java:567)
    at io.quarkus.deployment.ExtensionLoader$2.execute (ExtensionLoader.java:938)
    at io.quarkus.builder.BuildContext.run (BuildContext.java:273)
    at org.jboss.threads.ContextClassLoaderSavingRunnable.run (ContextClassLoaderSavingRunnable.java:35)
    at org.jboss.threads.EnhancedQueueExecutor.safeRun (EnhancedQueueExecutor.java:2027)
    at org.jboss.threads.EnhancedQueueExecutor$ThreadBody.doRunTask (EnhancedQueueExecutor.java:1551)
    at org.jboss.threads.EnhancedQueueExecutor$ThreadBody.run (EnhancedQueueExecutor.java:1442)
    at java.lang.Thread.run (Thread.java:830)
    at org.jboss.threads.JBossThread.run (JBossThread.java:479)
```

**Additional context**
Interesting thing is: `./mvnw clean compile quarkus:dev` works!

Possibly the `--enable-preview` flag is not passed from compilerArgs/jvmArgs on to the java compiler/runtime (whatever quarkus is executing) when running the `build` goal.

There are two hints to support this guess:

1. when running with -X -e, I find these lines:
```
[DEBUG] Configuring mojo 'io.quarkus:quarkus-maven-plugin:1.3.2.Final:build' with basic configurator -->
[DEBUG]   (f) buildDir = /Users/christophlinder/foo/standard-annotation-fail/target
[DEBUG]   (f) finalName = enable-preview-fail-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT
[DEBUG]   (f) generatedSourcesDirectory = /Users/christophlinder/foo/standard-annotation-fail/target/generated-sources
[DEBUG]   (f) ignoredEntries = []
[DEBUG]   (f) outputDirectory = /Users/christophlinder/foo/standard-annotation-fail/target/classes
[DEBUG]   (f) pluginRepos = [dvbern.nexus (https://nexus.dvbern.ch/nexus/content/groups/allrepos/, default, releases+snapshots)]
[DEBUG]   (f) project = MavenProject: org.acme:enable-preview-fail:1.0.0-SNAPSHOT @ /Users/christophlinder/foo/standard-annotation-fail/pom.xml
[DEBUG]   (f) repoSession = org.eclipse.aether.DefaultRepositorySystemSession@3bd08435
[DEBUG]   (f) repos = [dvbern.nexus (https://nexus.dvbern.ch/nexus/content/groups/allrepos/, default, releases+snapshots)]
[DEBUG]   (f) skip = false
[DEBUG]   (f) uberJar = false
[DEBUG] -- end configuration --
```
(i.e.: no compilerArgs/jvmArgs passed to build mojo)

2. when setting `MAVEN_OPTS="--enable-preview"`, quarkus build works!
